# Human-Agent Ally Lab (HAA Lab)

> Research laboratory at the National Institute of Informatics (NII), Tokyo, Japan,
> led by Dr. Chung-Chi Chen. We research human-agent teaming, LLM-based agent design,
> and the societal impact of intelligent agents — "preparing for the human-agent society."

Key facts:
- PI: Dr. Chung-Chi Chen, Assistant Professor at NII; founder of ACL SIG-FinTech;
  SIGIR Early Career Researcher Award recipient. Homepage: https://nlpfin.github.io/
- Three research pillars: (1) Agent Design & Agentic Frameworks (IR for agents,
  LLM-based architectures, performance & efficiency); (2) Human-Agent Teaming
  (higher-order thinking augmentation, high-stakes decision-making, high-fidelity
  interaction); (3) Human-Agent Society (societal transformation, impact analysis,
  governance & policy design).
- 100+ publications at venues including ACL, EMNLP, SIGIR, WWW, CIKM, LREC, NAACL, COLM.
- Organizes the FinNLP workshop series (10+ editions), NTCIR shared tasks
  (FinNum, FinArg, RegCom), and SemEval tasks (NumEval, PromiseEval).
- Recruiting PhD students (via SOKENDAI), research interns (via NII MOU program),
  and postdoctoral fellows. Working language: English. Contact: chen@nii.ac.jp
